meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 增加新能力或改行为：先问清你的目标，再优先调用现成技能来添加频道、接入 MCP 集成，或修改人格、触发规则与部署，最后告诉你怎么验证。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 添加频道（Telegram、Slack 等）、接入新集成、修改触发规则或路由时触发；它会先提问确认需求。

say.text: 帮我加一个 Telegram 输入频道。
say.note: 它会先问接到哪个 agent group、隔离级别。

say.text: 给这个 agent group 加一个日历 MCP 工具。
改一下这个 agent group 的人格和回复风格。
say.note: 改的是该组的 CLAUDE.md 文件。

howto.what_en: Adds capabilities or changes NanoClaw behavior: it asks clarifying questions first, then prefers an existing skill to add channels, MCP integrations, persona, triggers, or deployment, and tells you how to verify.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a channel (Telegram, Slack, etc.), add an integration, change triggers or routing, or make other NanoClaw customizations.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel.
say_en.note: It asks which agent group and isolation level.

say_en.text: Add a calendar MCP tool to this agent group.
Change this agent group's persona and reply style.
